content.text: The letter reports the account's own returns (1.2% net, 1.4% gross, 2.8% YTD, 9.4% since inception) but never mentions the comparison index or its 1.7% Q2 2026 return.

points.evidence: The letter's performance paragraph states only: "your account returned 1.2% net of fees (1.4% gross of fees). There is no mention anywhere in the letter of the comparison index (50% global equity index / 50% US intermediate aggregate bond index) or its 1.7% Q2 2026 return.
